import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.*;

public class Test {
    int readInt() {
        int ans = 0;
        boolean neg = false;
        try {
            boolean start = false;
            for (int c = 0; (c = System.in.read()) != -1; ) {
                if (c == '-') {
                    start = true;
                    neg = true;
                    continue;
                } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                    start = true;
                    ans = ans * 10 + c - '0';
                } else if (start) break;
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
        }
        return neg ? -ans : ans;
    }

    int r, c;
    Scanner sca = new Scanner(System.in);
    long[][] C = new long[64][64];
    long best = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    void dfs(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long d = Math.abs(x - y);
        if (best <= 1 || d - C[v1][r]*C[v2][r] >= best) return;
        if (v1 == r - 1 && v2 == r - 1) {
            if (d < best) best = d;
            return;
        }
        if (v1 >= r) {
            long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1-1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
            dfs(x, y + c1*s2, v1 - 1, v2);
        }
        if (v2 >= r) {
            long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2-1][r];
            dfs(x + s1*c2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
        }
    }

    int[] cntA = new int[64], cntB = new int[64];
    Map[long, long] cache = {}
    char[] cs;

    long solve(long x, long y, int v1, int v2) {
        k = x*10000 + v1*100  + v2
        v = cache.get(k)
        if (v != null) return v
        v = 0l
        d = Math.abs(x - y)
        if (d - C[v1][r]*C[v2][r] > best) {
            cache.put(k, v)
            return v
        }
        if (v1 < r || v2 < r) {
            sum = v1 + v2
            if (v1 >= cntA[sum] && v2 >= cntB[sum]) {
                v1 -= cntA[sum]
                v2 -= cntB[sum]
                v = C[v1+v2][v1]
                cache.put(k, v)
                return v
            }
            cache.put(k, v)
            return v
        }
        c = cs[v1 + v2 - 1]
        if (c != 'B') {
            c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r]
            v += solve(x, y + c1*s2, v1 - 1, v2)
        }
        if (c != 'A') {
            s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2-1][r]
            v += solve( x + s1*c2, y, v1, v2 - 1)
        }
        cache.put(k, v)
        return v
    }

    void start() {
        r = sca.nextInt(); c = sca.nextInt(); sca.nextLine()
        cs = sca.nextLine().toCharArray()
        for i in range(2*(r + c) + 1):
            for j in range(2*(r + c) + 1):
                if j == 0: C[i][j] = 1
                elif i == 0: C[i][j] = 0
                else: C[i][j] = C[i-1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j]
        v1 = r + c, v2 = r + c
        x = 0, y = 0
        while v1 >= r and v2 >= r:
            if x > y:
                c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r]
                y += c1*s2
                v1 -= 1
            else:
                s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2-1][r]
                x += s1*c2
                v2 -= 1
        best = abs(x - y)
        dfs(0, 0, r + c, r + c)
        for i in range(2*(r+c)):
            cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (cs[i] == 'A')
            cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (cs[i] == 'B')
        ans = solve(0, 0, r + c, r + c)
        print(ans)
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Test().start()
    }
}
